changelog: - **Values in the model list, clearer groups, larger small text.** The model list shows each Parameter's value and each Pool's value (its start value, or the run's value while it runs) at the end of its row; a long value is cut short there, and the row's name still reads it whole. Each kind's heading (Parameters, Sources, Pools…) is bold with its count at the end, and the groups have a little space between them. With the timeline hidden, its button in the run bar reads Timeline, and New results once the run has moved on since it was hidden; the timeline still opens only when you open it. The run bar's and the timeline's smallest labels (Speed, Seed, Timeline, CSV, Live / Distribution) are larger, their small buttons are one height, and a canvas hint's close button is easier to press. The strip that holds a canvas hint under the tool row is a little thinner.
